rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for taking part in an event, activity, or group.

example.english: I'm really looking forward to my participation in the school singing contest this year.
example.traditional: 我好期待今年參加學校嘅歌唱比賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 gam1 nin4 caam1 gaa1 hok6 haau6 ge3 go1 coeng3 bei2 coi3

rows.note: Use this when the participation means active involvement in a project, discussion, process, or decision rather than simply joining an event.

example.english: Your participation in this discussion is what made the decision so comprehensive.
example.traditional: 你有參與今次討論，個決定先至咁全面。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 caam1 jyu5 gam1 ci3 tou2 leon6 go3 kyut3 ding6 sin1 zi3 gam3 cyun4 min6
